announcements.headline: NACON: Update on the judicial reorganisation proceedings
announcements.insight: Judicial reorganisation proceedings continue following the observation period extension in May and delayed financial statements in July. Shareholders should monitor for further court decisions regarding the company's survival.

announcements.headline: NACON - Nacon takes note of the Bigben Interactive press release - ENGLISH TRANSLATION
announcements.insight: Nacon acknowledges a Bigben Interactive release. This follows May's judicial reorganisation extension and July's financial statement postponement, indicating ongoing restructuring.

announcements.headline: NACON: Postponement of the publication of the annual financial statements for the financial year ended 31 March 2026 and of the annual financial report 2025/2026
announcements.insight: The postponement of annual financial statements follows an extension of the judicial reorganisation observation period in May 2026. This delay highlights ongoing restructuring uncertainty for shareholders.

announcements.headline: PRESS RELEASE: NACON: Extension of the observation period for the judicial reorganisation proceedings
announcements.insight: The observation period for judicial reorganisation proceedings has been extended. Shareholders should monitor further court updates regarding the company's restructuring status.
